truth_rule: These are routed virtual execution capacity units, not 2500 independent persistent employees. A unit counts only when attached to a task_id, owner, canonical output, KPI and proof.
operating_rules: No capacity unit may create generic planning when a higher-value executable task exists.
No learning output counts without before-after evaluation and regression proof.
No revenue output counts without a buyer, offer, distribution path, payment path and tracked state.
Duplicate work is merged; blocked work immediately switches to the next highest-value executable task.
Every squad keeps specialist ownership and uses CEO-level reasoning about money, risk, priority and proof.

financial_independence_gate.definition: Twelve-month average recurring gross profit must cover operating costs plus the configured owner draw with a 50 percent safety margin, while maintaining at least six months of operating reserve.
financial_independence_gate.hard_proof: Recurring customer payments and delivered value, not projected revenue or unsigned pipeline.
